setupTitle: Set up Eco Gnome in 4 steps
replace2: with your identifier, without the braces.

steps.accountText: Go to Eco Gnome and sign in.
steps.joinText: On Eco Gnome, join our server with the join code above.
steps.linkText: Get your secretid: click your username at the top right of Eco Gnome. Then type the command below in the game chat.
steps.backupText: Download a backup of your account with the (blue) download button. Without it, your prices may be lost.

commands.join: Opens Eco Gnome and joins this server directly.
commands.open: Opens Eco Gnome in your browser.
commands.syncRoom: Updates the prices of items for sale in the room you are in.
commands.syncDeed: Same thing, for the whole property you are on.
